Reorient: Reorient camera - back to the view the area opened with
DragHint: Drag to move · Alt+drag to turn · Ctrl snaps 0.5 m
TileHeightHint: Raise and lower move this tile one height level
RotateRandomly: Turn the selection to a random angle

LowerTile: Lower the selected tile one height level (minimum level 0)
